title: On the Importance of Hidden-State Refinement in Masked Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.32416v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked or corrupted token sequences, allowing token predictions to condition on bidirectional context and update multiple positions in parallel. While each denoising step produces a rich layer-wise hidden-state trajectory, prior work typically focuses only on token-level information and discards these continuous hidden states, leaving their refinement dynamics underexplored. translated_title: 论掩码扩散语言模型中隐藏状态精炼的重要性
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）通过迭代去噪被掩码或损坏的词元序列来生成文本，使词元预测能够以双向上下文为条件并并行更新多个位置。尽管每个去噪步骤都会产生丰富的逐层隐藏状态轨迹，但先前的工作通常只关注词元级别的信息而丢弃这些连续的隐藏状态，使其精炼动态尚未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们分析了MDLM中的隐藏状态动态，并发现了逐层和跨步骤精炼的明确证据：相邻层之间的平滑演化、更深层具有更强的预测能力、移除Transformer块后的渐进退化，以及连续去噪步骤之间最终状态的强对齐。基于这些观察，我们提出了跨步骤循环精炼（CSRR）机制，该机制在去噪步骤之间传递隐藏状态信息以增强模型性能。
tldr: 该论文揭示了掩码扩散语言模型中隐藏状态的逐层与跨步骤精炼动态，并据此提出跨步骤循环精炼（CSRR）机制，通过在去噪步骤间传递隐藏状态信息来增强模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the layer-wise and cross-step refinement dynamics of hidden states in masked diffusion language models and proposes Cross-Step Recurrent Refinement (CSRR), a mechanism that carries hidden-state information across denoising steps to enhance model performance.
